work.title: Guernica, Bomber Above
work.description: Vertical collage juxtaposing a cyan field bearing a schematic four-engine bomber overhead with the word 'GuErNiC' in white bold type on green; below, a red rectangle frames a black-and-white photograph of a ruined building and tree, with a dense photographic band of figures and rubble at bottom.
work.composition: two-register flag, bomber over destruction photograph
